tells.1: Template triad ('talk through... go over... and catch up') and a hedged closer that doesn't match the ask.
tells.2: Welcome line tacked on at the end, then a close that stacks three stock sentiments.
tells.3: Says the same thing twice ('you're not alone' / 'same boat'), then parks the welcome at the end.
tells.5: Performed opener ('Well... certainly kept us on our toes'), a buried welcome, and an em-dash sign-off.

reason: Version 4 opens where a newsletter should, invites people to the workshop in a specific voice, and stops without padding. The others bury the welcome, lean on parallel lists and hedges, or perform casualness.
